_review: full-file pass by a model acting as a native-level reviewer (not a human native speaker). Product nouns pinned by the glossary stay in Latin as one family (workflow, endpoint, gateway, slot, dead letter, sink, landed); stream, buffer, manifest, hook, backfill and legacy are in katakana. A human native speaker is still wanted for: state.degraded (性能低下), state.quiet (受信なし), state.stale (古い) and state.on_time (予定どおり) as status words; the "実際の値はこれ以上です" wording for a lower bound (metrics.dropped, metrics.partial, streams.health.replicas_partial); the summary.* fragments, which the server joins with ASCII commas and a final period, so they read as plain-form notes rather than finished sentences; and whether engineers prefer ワークフロー and エンドポイント over the Latin words.
